annotations.text:
Ask — a project-level chat that draws.

Top row is one view in four states, left to right: new thread, answered with a canvas, answering while researching the web, canvas focused with a node inspector. Bottom row is the web-access control and the node vocabulary.

Everything is lifted from the running app — Outfit / Inter / Fira Code, violet · cyan · emerald · amber, 12px panel radius, the existing chat-bubble and glass-panel rules. The diagrams are native Demeteo canvases, not images: each node carries a real path in this repo.

Support sheets.

Left: web access as a lever on the permission model that already exists — an Ask thread is a read-only capability with network: Allow, and the amber note follows the ConfinementBanner pattern of saying out loud what nothing enforces.

Right: the node card, so a generated diagram reads the same as a workflow graph.
